# Installed into both Python runtimes in the image: cs50/cli's python3 (the default
# for check50 jobs) and the Python 3.14 TensorFlow runtime at /opt/tensorflow, so
# a check behaves the same whichever runtime it is routed to (see check50-runtime).
# Every pin here therefore needs a wheel for both interpreters' Python versions:
# cp314 and, so that cs50/cli can move to 3.15 (cs50/cli#254), cp315.
# The TensorFlow stack itself is in requirements-tensorflow.txt.
